storage.rule: Library files may use explicit-record or gcl02-columnar-v1 storage. Columnar rows reconstruct named compact fields strictly by the versioned columns array before deterministic GCL-01 materialization; no semantic defaults are inferred from position beyond that declared mapping.

driver_families.intent: Something familiar changes, fails, contradicts itself or behaves impossibly.
A promise, duty, debt, oath, guardianship or reciprocal expectation creates engagement.
A person, object, route, memory, resource, place or expected future is missing.
Access, knowledge, shelter, resources, alliances or openings create reasons to act.
A clock, shortage, approaching force, spread, coercion or irreversible decision creates pressure.
A request, contract, rescue, delivery, mediation, expertise need or sponsor relationship draws the party in.
Blame, legitimacy, identity, status, possession, betrayal or public narrative is contested.
Friendship, rivalry, mentorship, loyalty, autonomy, reconciliation or trust becomes actionable.
A clue, confession, hidden space, false history, intercepted message, witness or concealed link opens a question.
Another actor wants the same target, window, status, route, resource or public narrative.
A stranger, authority, technology, migration, delegation, heir or returning actor changes the local state.
Prior victories, crises, defeated powers, rescues, revelations or world changes create new unfinished business.

intent_first_facets.genre_strategy: All GCL-02 v0.1.0 records are structural genre_neutral hooks. GCL-15 owns mature genre/tone reskinning grammar; a consumer may bind setting expression without changing hook identity or authority.
intent_first_facets.normal_access_rule: Recommend by current GM need and playable intent first. Driver-family and expert tags are secondary browse dimensions, not the default giant-list UI.

completion_note: This 120-record corpus exceeds the GCL-18 starter proof target of 100 hooks/premises while remaining parameterized. GCL-18 may curate subsets or proof packs from it later; GCL-02 completion does not imply GCL-18 completion.
